text:
maria chen: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — Stratus6B model card: long-context bench numbers, limits, SDK v3 snippet migration. PTAL @kevin @evan

kevin li: looking

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed ✅ — preview: https://deploy.preview/stratus6b-card

evan park: Quick q: do we have seq len ceiling? The model internally can 65k tokens? Need to clarify tokenization mismatch.

maria chen: Tested seq 32k w/ kv-cache warm. We see memory spike on A100-80GB at bs=1 for 32k -> recommend max_sequence_length: 32768 and note 'long-context memory and perf vary by batch/quant'.

sophia rogers: Can you add the small benchmark table? I'll tweak phrasing. Also SDK snippet needs SDK v3 code sample.

maria chen: Snippet I used (working):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
resp = client.generate(model='stratus6b', input='Summarize...', max_tokens=256)
print(resp.output_text)
```
But SDK v3 wants streaming example and function call change, see below.

maria chen: SDK v2 -> v3 migration note: replace client.completions.create(...) with client.generate(...). Also streaming uses `.stream()` iterator. I'll add small diff.

kevin li: @maria can you add note about preferred quant profile: q4_k_m and fallback q8? And compatibility with Dedicated infra older kernels (need backend-compat tag).

maria chen: Added note and CI preview updated.

docs-bot: Link check failed: found broken reference to /models/stratus6b/compatibility -> 404

evan park: I can fix link; should point to /models/stratus6b/compat

maria chen: Fixed link + updated PR.

sophia rogers: LGTM, minor nits: change '64k' -> '65k' where appropriate? Wait, earlier we set 32768. Replace ambiguous numbers. Also add 'hardware used' column in bench table.

kevin li: :thumbsup: I'd like a short migration snippet for the Java SDK too.

maria chen: Added Java snippet (short). Also added 'note: batch size and sequence length interact; see perf fig'

evan park: Approving PR. Merge on green.

sophia rogers: Approving too.

docs-bot: Merge status: All approvals received. Auto-merge scheduled after 5m.

maria chen: :party_parrot: thanks all — will follow-up with a small support doc about 'how to measure mem with nvidia-smi sample'
